post_content:
A lot of people ask me - which course to choose for Data Science. Over next
few days, I will give you some pointers to select the best course for yourself
Content offered is the key for any course - it makes or breaks you !! So
always ask for sample content and review it yourself. When I say sample - it's
not just one presentation. Ask for at least 5% of course content ! When
someone asks me for my End to End Data Science course - I don't share a demo.
I will share 'real' 5 classes of previous batch , presentations of at least 5
topics, all hands on used in first month, two use cases - completely solved
and a lot. In fact it takes 20 hours to review our 'sample' content.. The best
of my students are the ones who paid me after previewing the content and I
love to work with such students Are you one of them interested in End to End
DS course ?
